title: Transcontinental Gas Pipeline (Williams) — mainline + expansion projects
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary docket search on the project name (CP##-###) -> the certificate order and the application's Exhibit Z resource report for length/diameter/capacity; Williams newsroom + quarterly investor supplement (project table with in-service dates); EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects table; trade press (Natural Gas Intelligence, S&P Global Commodity Insights, Reuters).

title: Gulf South Gas Pipeline (Boardwalk) — Louisiana/Mississippi/Alabama expansions
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary by docket (Gulf South Pipeline Company LLC) -> certificate order + environmental assessment (facility tables give miles and pipe diameter per loop/segment); Boardwalk Pipelines press releases and Boardwalk Pipeline Partners 10-K project descriptions; EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects table; state permits (LDEQ, MDEQ).

title: Northwest Pipeline + MountainWest (Williams West) — mainline and reliability projects
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary (Northwest Pipeline LLC; MountainWest Pipeline LLC / Questar Pipeline predecessor dockets) -> certificate orders and EAs; Williams' MountainWest acquisition filings (2024) for current operator/owner naming; Washington/Oregon/Utah/Wyoming state siting dockets; EIA pipeline projects table. NOTE: the operator string moved 'Northwest Pipeline Co' -> 'Northwest Pipeline LLC' — record which spelling each source supports.

title: Louisiana Energy Access Project (DT Midstream) — expansion phases 1-3
source_ladder: DT Midstream investor presentations + earnings releases (LEAP phase capacity/in-service tables); DT Midstream 10-K; LEAP is intrastate so FERC has little — use Louisiana DNR/LDEQ permits and Louisiana Public Service Commission filings; trade press (NGI Shale Daily, Hart Energy).

title: Energy Transfer Texas/Louisiana intrastates — East Texas, HPL, Sabine, Tejas, Acadian, Magnolia
source_ladder: Texas Railroad Commission (RRC) gas utility filings + T-4 permits and the RRC public GIS pipeline viewer for operator identity; Energy Transfer LP 10-K segment descriptions (names each intrastate system and its miles); Energy Transfer newsroom; Louisiana DNR for Acadian; EIA-191/EIA state profiles. Intrastate systems are NOT in FERC eLibrary — do not report UNRESOLVED on an eLibrary miss alone.

title: Kinder Morgan systems — El Paso Natural Gas, Sierrita, NGPL, Stratton Ridge
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary (El Paso Natural Gas Company LLC; Sierrita Gas Pipeline LLC; Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America LLC) -> certificate orders and EAs; Kinder Morgan quarterly project backlog table + newsroom; KMI 10-K; for Sierrita's Mexico side, CRE/Sener permit records and CFE Gasoductos; EIA pipeline projects table.

title: TC Energy US gas — ANR, Columbia Gas/Gulf, Tuscarora
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary (ANR Pipeline Company; Columbia Gas Transmission LLC; Columbia Gulf Transmission LLC; Tuscarora Gas Transmission Company) -> certificate order + EA facility tables; TC Energy quarterly project tables and news releases; TC Energy 10-K/MD&A; EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects table; state agencies (Michigan PSC, WV DEP, Nevada).

title: Enbridge/partner northeast + midwest — Algonquin, TETCO, Vector, Alliance, PNGTS
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary (Algonquin Gas Transmission LLC; Texas Eastern Transmission LP; Vector Pipeline LP; Alliance Pipeline LP; Portland Natural Gas Transmission System) -> certificate orders + EAs; Enbridge gas transmission asset pages and quarterly project updates; for cross-border rows, CER (Canada Energy Regulator) records and the Presidential Permit; EIA pipeline projects table.

title: Permian-to-Mexico export corridor — Trans-Pecos, Comanche Trail, Roadrunner, Rio Bravo, Saguaro, Valley Crossing
source_ladder: FERC Presidential Permit / NGA section 3 border-crossing dockets (these are border facilities, not NGA-7 certificates — search by applicant); Mexico CRE permit registry and CFE/CENAGAS capacity documents for the southern leg; operator sites (ONEOK post-Magellan for Roadrunner/Comanche Trail, Enbridge for Valley Crossing, Oneok/WhiteWater, NextDecade for Rio Bravo, Oneok/Mexico Pacific for Saguaro); Texas RRC T-4 for the US-side operator; trade press.

title: WhiteWater/Summit Permian — Whistler mainline + laterals, Double E
source_ladder: WhiteWater Midstream news releases and the Whistler Pipeline joint-venture announcements (MPLX/Enbridge/I Squared ownership changes matter for the Operator flags); Summit Midstream / Double E Pipeline FERC docket CP19-98 (Double E IS FERC-jurisdictional); Texas RRC T-4 and the RRC GIS viewer; trade press (Hart Energy, Reuters, NGI). P7830 is the ORIGINAL oil-pipeline proposal record for Double E — check whether the diameter on it belongs to the oil proposal or the gas build.

title: Appalachian + eastern trunks — TGP, EGTS, East Tennessee, Mountaineer, REX, DeRuyter
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary (Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company LLC; Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage Inc — formerly Dominion Energy Transmission; East Tennessee Natural Gas LLC; Rockies Express Pipeline LLC) -> certificate orders + EAs; Kinder Morgan (TGP, EETN) and Berkshire Hathaway Energy (EGTS) project pages; WV/VA/TN/NY state DEP and PSC dockets; NY PSC for DeRuyter; EIA pipeline projects table.

title: Florida Gas Transmission + Enable — southeast trunk expansions
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary (Florida Gas Transmission Company LLC; Enable Gas Transmission LLC, now Energy Transfer after the 2021 merger — the Operator flag likely IS the merger) -> certificate orders + EAs with per-loop mileage and diameter; Energy Transfer and Kinder Morgan (Citrus 50/50) disclosures; Alabama PSC / Florida PSC; EIA pipeline projects table.

title: LNG feedgas laterals — Delfin, Port Arthur, Freeport, ADCC, Creole Trail, Pomelo
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary by the LNG project docket (the feedgas pipeline is usually an exhibit to the terminal application) plus MARAD/USCG deepwater-port records for Delfin; DOE/FE export authorizations; developer sites (Sempra Infrastructure, Freeport LNG, Cheniere, Delfin Midstream, WhiteWater for ADCC); Texas RRC T-4 for intrastate laterals; trade press. ADCC and Pomelo are intrastate — an eLibrary miss is not evidence.

title: Permian + midcontinent gathering/intrastate — Delaware Basin, Hill Lake, Lowman, Agua Blanca, Targa Bull Run, Cimarron River
source_ladder: Texas RRC T-4 permits and the RRC GIS pipeline viewer (operator + commissioning date); Targa Resources and Kinetik (Agua Blanca) investor decks and 10-Ks; New Mexico OCD and Oklahoma Corporation Commission records; company news releases for in-service dates; trade press. These are NOT FERC-jurisdictional — the Date_logic flags are usually a commissioning-year question the RRC permit date answers.

title: Remaining systems — Northern Natural, Trunkline, MVP Southgate, CP Express, Point Comfort, Island Gas Connector, Centra
source_ladder: FERC eLibrary per operator (Northern Natural Gas Company; Trunkline Gas Company LLC; Mountain Valley Pipeline LLC for Southgate, docket CP19-14; Columbia/TC for CP Express) -> certificate orders + EAs; Berkshire Hathaway Energy (Northern Natural) and Energy Transfer (Trunkline) asset pages; NC DEQ + Virginia DEQ for Southgate; Texas RRC for Point Comfort and Island Gas Connector; Michigan PSC for Centra; EIA pipeline projects table.

title: Alaska intrastate gas — Kenai/Beluga and the Anchorage system
source_ladder: Alaska Regulatory Commission (RCA) filings and tariff dockets for Harvest Alaska / Hilcorp (Kenai Beluga Pipeline) and ENSTAR Natural Gas Company (Anchorage system); Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas right-of-way lease records (gives the original commissioning year the Date_logic flags turn on); Alaska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission; PHMSA operator annual reports for the gas transmission mileage; Hilcorp/Harvest and ENSTAR company pages; Alaska Journal of Commerce and Alaska Beacon for in-service reporting. These are intrastate and pre-date most digital records — a 1960s-70s original in-service date will come from the RCA/DNR record or a retrospective, not a press release.
